questions.question: Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements. Statements: Some pens are boxes. No box is a fan. Some pens are fans. Conclusions: I. No pen is a fan. Il. No box is a pen. III. Some fans are pens. IV. Some boxes are pens.
questions.questionHtml:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

Some pens are boxes.

No box is a fan.

Some pens are fans.

Conclusions:

I. No pen is a fan.

Il. No box is a pen.

III. Some fans are pens.

IV. Some boxes are pens.

options.text: Only conclusions I and III follow
options.html: Only conclusions I and III follow

options.text: Only conclusions Il and IV follow
options.html: Only conclusions Il and IV follow

options.text: Only conclusions I and Il follow
options.html: Only conclusions I and Il follow

options.text: Only conclusions Ill and IV follow
options.html: Only conclusions Ill and IV follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

Conclusions:

I. No pen is a fan → Does not Follow (As, no box is a fan and some pens are fans. So, no direct negative or cross relation is given between pens and fan therefore it is definitely false)

II. No box is a pen → Does not Follow (As, some pens are boxes and no box is a fan. So, no direct negative or cross relation is given between pens and box therefore it is definitely false)

III. Some fans are pens → Follow (As, some pens are fans. So, as some part of pens is common with fans therefore it is definitely true.)

IV. Some boxes are pens → Follow (As, some pens are boxes. So, as some part of pens is common with boxes therefore it is definitely true.)

So, Only conclusions Ill and IV follow.

questions.question: In this question, three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, Il and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follows/follow from the statements. Statements: Some spoons are black. All black are crows. No crow is a plate. Conclusions: I. Some black are spoons. Il. All crows are black. III. No plate is a crow.
questions.questionHtml:
In this question, three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, Il and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follows/follow from the statements.

Statements:

Some spoons are black.

All black are crows.

No crow is a plate.

Conclusions:

I. Some black are spoons.

Il. All crows are black.

III. No plate is a crow.

options.text: Only conclusions I and Ill follow.
options.html: Only conclusions I and Ill follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

Conclusions:

I. Some black are spoons → Follow (As, some spoons are black. So, as some part of spoons is common with black therefore it is definitely true.)

II. All crows are black → Does not Follow (As, All black are crows. So, it is possible but not definitely true)

III. No plate is a crow → Follow (As, no crow is a plate. So, direct cross or negative relation is given between plate and crow therefore it is definitely true.)

So, Only conclusions I and Ill follow.

options.text: use of more labour and capital inputs on the given land under cultivation
options.html: use of more labour and capital inputs on the given land under cultivation

options.text: spreading farming across more states of India
options.html: spreading farming across more states of India

questions.solution: Intensive agriculture, also known as intensive farming, maximizes agricultural production from a given area of land using higher inputs of labour, machinery, and other farming resources. Intensive agriculture uses practices like irrigation, advanced fertilizers, and other technological inputs to generate a high output per unit of land, making it well-suited for regions with high population density where land is in short supply.

questions.question: Nana Sahib, a rebel at Kanpur was the son of which of the following Peshwas?
questions.questionHtml: Nana Sahib, a rebel at Kanpur was the son of which of the following Peshwas?
questions.solution: Nana Sahib, born as Dhondu Pant was adopted by Baji Rao II, who was the last Peshwa of the Maratha Empire. He led the revolt in the region of Kanpur (Cawnpore) and despite initial successes, was defeated by British forces later on.

questions.question: Which of the following hill stations do NOT experience snowfall in winters?
questions.questionHtml: Which of the following hill stations do NOT experience snowfall in winters?
questions.solution: Ooty, located in Tamil Nadu, does not experience snowfall in winters due to its relatively milder climate compared to northern hill stations like Nainital, Shimla, and Srinagar, which do experience snowfall. Despite being a hill station, Ooty's temperatures are not low enough for snow.

questions.question: Schools and hostels under the Ministry of Education's Samagra Shiksha scheme will be renamed after:
questions.questionHtml: Schools and hostels under the Ministry of Education's Samagra Shiksha scheme will be renamed after:
questions.solution: In a tribute to Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose, the Ministry of Education has decided to name residential schools and hostels funded under the Samagra Shiksha Scheme as "Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose residential schools/hostels". This is reflective of the central government's effort to honour the memory and contributions of the legendary freedom fighter, acknowledging his role as a key figure in India's freedom struggle.

questions.question: What helps making the acidic food alkaline that is coming from the stomach?
questions.questionHtml: What helps making the acidic food alkaline that is coming from the stomach?
questions.solution: Bile juice is secreted by the liver and stored in the gallbladder. It is released into the small intestine when food enters. Bile neutralizes the acid in chyme, raising its pH and making the intestinal environment more alkaline. Along with neutralizing the acid, bile aids in the emulsification of dietary fat, which helps in its digestion.

questions.question: For which discovery did William Bradford Shockley, John Bardeen and Walter Houser Brattain jointly receive the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1956?
questions.questionHtml: For which discovery did William Bradford Shockley, John Bardeen and Walter Houser Brattain jointly receive the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1956?

options.text: Discovery of receptors for temperature and touch
options.html: Discovery of receptors for temperature and touch

questions.solution: In 1956, William Bradford Shockley, John Bardeen, and Walter Houser Brattain jointly received the Nobel Prize in Physics for their research on semiconductors and their discovery of the transistor effect. The transistor effect they discovered is a fundamental principle that forms the basis for the functioning of transistors, pivotal components in virtually all modern electronic devices.

questions.question: Which group of rivers is a part of the peninsular drainage system?
questions.questionHtml: Which group of rivers is a part of the peninsular drainage system?
questions.solution: Mahanadi and Godavari are two of the major rivers that are part of the Peninsular drainage system in India. The Peninsular River System, unlike the Himalayan River System, is mainly composed of older rivers that have a fixed course and do not substantially change direction or characteristics with seasons.

questions.question: Ashoka sent a mission to spread the principle of Dhamma led by his son, Mahendra and daughter, Sanghamitra to _______.
questions.questionHtml: Ashoka sent a mission to spread the principle of Dhamma led by his son, Mahendra and daughter, Sanghamitra to _______.
questions.solution: Emperor Ashoka sent Buddhist missions to various places to spread the principles of Dhamma (Buddhist teachings). His son, Mahendra (also referred to as Mahinda), and daughter, Sanghamitra, were sent to Ceylon (present-day Sri Lanka). They played a key role in establishing Theravada Buddhism as the major religion in the region.

questions.question: If the government revenue expenditure exceeds revenue receipt, It is called:
questions.questionHtml: If the government revenue expenditure exceeds revenue receipt, It is called:
questions.solution: When a government's revenue expenditure exceeds revenue receipts, it is termed as a revenue deficit. A revenue deficit essentially means that the government's own earnings are insufficient to meet the operational costs of running government departments and provision of services.

questions.question: Paramvir Chakra, Ashok Chakra and Vir Chakra are presented during the celebration of which day?
questions.questionHtml: Paramvir Chakra, Ashok Chakra and Vir Chakra are presented during the celebration of which day?
questions.solution: The Param Vir Chakra, Ashok Chakra, and Vir Chakra are among India's highest military honors and are presented during Republic Day celebrations on January 26. This day marks the enactment of India's Constitution, establishing it as a republic. The awards are presented by the President of India during the Republic Day parade. The Ashoka Chakra can be awarded to both military and civilian personnel and can be posthumously awarded. Independence Day on August 15, Gandhi Jayanti on October 2, and Indian Air Force Day on October 8 do not typically feature the presentation of these high military honors.

questions.question: The musician Sivamani is associated with which musical instrument?
questions.questionHtml: The musician Sivamani is associated with which musical instrument?
questions.solution: Sivamani, known by his stage name Drums Sivamani, is a renowned percussionist from India. He plays many instruments including drums, octoban, darbuka, udukai, ghatam, and kanjira. Over his career, he has performed in various stages and for different types of events, including the IPL Championships in 2008 and 2010.

questions.question: Who among the following was the slave-general of Alauddin Khilji, who led his army in the battle against Ramachandra of Devagiri?
questions.questionHtml: Who among the following was the slave-general of Alauddin Khilji, who led his army in the battle against Ramachandra of Devagiri?
questions.solution: Malik Kafur was the slave-general of Alauddin Khilji. He led Alauddin Khilji's army in the battle against Ramachandra of Devagiri. Malik Kafur's military leadership and strategic skills were instrumental in the Khilji dynasty's expansion. Malik Kafur played a key role in the history of medieval India as a trusted general and commander in various battles.

questions.question: Padma Shri awardee In 2022, Arjun Singh Dhurve, Is a tribal dancer of which of the following dance forms?
questions.questionHtml: Padma Shri awardee In 2022, Arjun Singh Dhurve, Is a tribal dancer of which of the following dance forms?
questions.solution: Arjun Singh Dhurve, a tribal artist, was awarded the prestigious Padma Shri in 2022. Dhurve is known for his contribution to the traditional Baiga dance. This dance form belongs to the Baiga tribe, an ancient and significant tribe mainly residing in states like Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, and Odisha.

questions.question: The number of on-field umpires in cricket matches is _______?
questions.questionHtml: The number of on-field umpires in cricket matches is _______?
questions.solution: Generally, there are two on-field umpires in cricket matches. One umpire typically stands behind the stumps at the bowler's end and the second umpire stands at square leg or a little behind, allowing them to judge line calls more accurately, such as wides or no-balls due to front foot faults.

questions.question: Borgeet is associated with which Indian classical dance form?
questions.questionHtml: Borgeet is associated with which Indian classical dance form?
questions.solution: Borgeet is associated with the Sattriya Indian classical dance form. It is a genre of devotional music from Assam, composed to praise Lord Krishna. Borgeet adds a spiritual dimension to Sattriya dance performances. It combines rhythmic movements with soulful melodies, creating a harmonious expression of devotion.

questions.question: ‘BFSI’ stands for Banking, Financial Services and _____ in India. It is a broad term for industries that offer financial products and services.
questions.questionHtml: ‘BFSI’ stands for Banking, Financial Services and _____ in India. It is a broad term for industries that offer financial products and services.
questions.solution: 'BFSI' stands for Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in India. It represents a wide range of industries that provide financial products and services to individuals and businesses. The term encompasses banking, involving deposit and loan services. The BFSI sector is crucial for the economy, contributing to financial stability and growth.

questions.question: What happens to the atomic size as you go down the group?
questions.questionHtml: What happens to the atomic size as you go down the group?
questions.solution: The atomic size increases as you go down a group in the periodic table. This increase is due to the addition of new electron shells or energy levels. As more electron shells are added, the outermost electrons are farther from the nucleus. The increased shielding effect from inner electrons also contributes to the larger atomic size.

questions.question: The Fundamental Duties of citizens were added to the Constitution of India, upon the recommendations of which of the following committees?
questions.questionHtml: The Fundamental Duties of citizens were added to the Constitution of India, upon the recommendations of which of the following committees?
questions.solution: The Fundamental Duties of citizens were incorporated into the Constitution of India. This addition was based on the recommendations of the Swaran Singh Committee. The 42nd Amendment Act of 1976 introduced these Fundamental Duties to the Indian Constitution.

questions.question: Which of the following statements are correct regarding the Centre-State Relations pertaining to the three lists of the Indian Constitution? A. The subjects which are not included in any of the three lists are called Residuary subjects. B. If there is any conflict between the Union List and the State List, then the former prevails. C. When the Parliament enacts a law on the request of two or more states, then that law made by the Parliament on the State List Is applicable to all the states.
questions.questionHtml:
Which of the following statements are correct regarding the Centre-State Relations pertaining to the three lists of the Indian Constitution? 

A. The subjects which are not included in any of the three lists are called Residuary subjects.

B. If there is any conflict between the Union List and the State List, then the former prevails.

C. When the Parliament enacts a law on the request of two or more states, then that law made by the Parliament on the State List Is applicable to all the states.
questions.solution: According to the Constitution, the residuary subjects, or those subjects that are not mentioned in any of the three lists, fall under the authority of the Central Government. In case of a conflict,  the law made by the Union Parliament prevails over the State law. This is to ensure the supremacy of the national perspective. If two or more states request the Parliament to enact a law on a subject that falls under the State List, then this law is applicable only to those states that requested it.

questions.question: 15 men and 21 women, working together, can do a job in 56 days, while 12 men and 24 women, working together, can do the same job in 64 days. In how many days can the same job be done by 18 men and 24 women, working together?

questions.solution:
(15 M + 21 W) × 56 = (12 M + 24 W) × 64 ⇒ (15 M + 21 W) × 7 = (12 M + 24 W) × 8 ⇒ 9 M = 45 W ⇒ M/W = 5/1

Required time taken to complete work = {(15 × 5) + 21) × 56}/(18 × 5) + 24 × 1 ⇒ (96 × 56)/114 = (16 × 56)/19 = 47\(\frac{3}{19}\) days

questions.question: If the selling price of an article is doubled, then the profit becomes four times. What was the original profit percentage?
questions.questionHtml: If the selling price of an article is doubled, then the profit becomes four times. What was the original profit percentage?
questions.solution:
4 × (S.P - C.P) = (2 × S.P - C.P) ⇒ 4 S.P - 4 C.P = 2 S.P - C.P ⇒ 2 S.P = 3 C.P ⇒ S.P/C.P = 3/2

Profit percentage = {(3 - 2) × 100}/2 = 100/2 = 50%.

questions.question: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice. She is laughing at me.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

She is laughing at me.

options.text: I am being laughed at by her.
options.html: I am being laughed at by her.

options.text: I have been laughed by her.
options.html: I have been laughed by her.

options.text: I was being laughed at by her.
options.html: I was being laughed at by her.

options.text: I had been laughed by her.

questions.solution: In passive voice, the object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive sentence. The verb is changed to the passive form "be + past participle." The subject of the active sentence becomes the agent (or doer) of the action in the passive sentence which is introduced by "by". Therefore, "She is laughing at me" becomes "I am being laughed at by her" in passive voice.

questions.question: Select the grammatically correct sentence. A. It is a old uniform but a memorable thing for me. B. It is old uniform but a memorable thing for me. C. It is the old uniform but memorable thing for me. D. It is an old uniform but a memorable thing for me.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the grammatically correct sentence.

A. It is a old uniform but a memorable thing for me.

B. It is old uniform but a memorable thing for me.

C. It is the old uniform but memorable thing for me.

D. It is an old uniform but a memorable thing for me.
questions.solution: The correct answer is: (D. It is an old uniform but a memorable thing for me). The sentence uses the correct article "an" before "old uniform" because "old" starts with a vowel sound. The sentence also uses the correct article "a" before "memorable thing" because "memorable" starts with a consonant sound. Thus, the correct answer is option 1.

questions.solution: A travel or voyage conducted for a specified purpose, frequently involving exploration or study, is referred to as an expedition.
